newsitem.title: INDIA: India metals prices mixed, zinc up on world trends.
newsitem.headline: India metals prices mixed, zinc up on world trends.

text.p: Indian zinc prices on Tuesday extended gains on favourable worldwide trends, traders said.
Other base metals moved in a narrow range and finished on a quieter note.
Zinc prices rose by 50 rupees at 8,450 rupees per quintal on the back of limited supplies coupled with fresh industrial cum speculative buying influenced by an upsurge in the world market.
Zinc was up by 50 rupees on Monday after gaining 100 rupees last week.
"Sentiment was firm on expectation that the state-owned Hindustan Zinc Ltd may hike selling prices for August," he said.
Copper was steady at 13,500 rupees per quintal, aluminium at 7,800 rupees and lead at 4,200 rupees per quintal amid limited activity.
Volumes were dull as major players kept away anticipating an announcement of sale pricess by state-owned producers for August.
Tin consolidated gains at 29,100 rupees per quintal and nickel at 34,100 rupees. Tin was up by 100 rupees and nickel by 300 rupees on Monday.
